description: QVYX is a three-person student team from Tajikistan. Jahongir Norov, our captain, and Toir Turazoda develop the software; Zeboniso Azizova leads design, presentation, and the project submission. We brought these roles together to turn a space-health challenge into a working prototype with a real smartwatch and a web dashboard. Our different strengths help us test the same idea from the perspectives of the astronaut, the crew, and the person using the system.
